items.title: Announcing Agent-to-Agent Interoperability Between  AWS AI Services and SAP Agents
items.summary: Authors Paul Balasubramaniam, Manoj Muthukrishnan, Ganesh Suryanarayanan, Arne Knoeller, Vikas Motiwal (SAP), Kay Schmitteckert (SAP), Praveen Padegal (SAP) AWS and SAP now support the agentic integration via open protocols, enabling autonomous cross-system business processes at enterprise scale. The autonomous enterprise depends on AI agents that can complete business processes that run across both SAP and […]
